notes: Lines 48-141 and 187-231: read Rotterdam data, derive sizecat/gradecat, Winsorize pgr/nodes at the 99th percentile, descriptive stats, overall + reverse Kaplan-Meier, then PROC PHREG on sizecat/gradecat/nodes. Runs against a 30-row sample (15 events/15 censored) of Data/rotterdam.csv inlined as DATALINES instead of PROC IMPORT from the author's local path. The combined 2-pair RENAME=(pr=pgr nod=nodes) dataset option in the original data r1 step is split into two single-pair-rename steps (data r0 then data r1) because Jenner currently drops only the last pair's original column correctly when a RENAME= option has 2+ pairs in one step (filed as a set/ regression candidate). The complex PROC LIFETEST PLOTS=(S(ATRISK(...)...)) ODS graphics option is dropped (Jenner does not yet parse that PLOTS= suboption grammar); the underlying TIME/ODS EXCLUDE statements and the estimator itself are unchanged. The nodes1/pgr1 restricted-cubic-spline covariates (normally produced by Functions/RCSPLINE macro.sas, %included in the original script) are omitted from the PHREG model because Jenner's %GOTO does not exit an iterative %DO loop early, which breaks RCSPLINE's own knot-count guard for any call with fewer than 10 knots (filed as EastAgile/jenner-language PR #14693, merged) — the model here uses the linear nodes term only, everything else (sizecat, gradecat, ties=efron, rl) is exactly the original model specification.
